research_summary.title: GoDaddy Domain Expiration & Auction Process: Risk Assessment for 6 GoDaddy Domains
research_summary.critical_finding: ALL GoDaddy-registered domains (registered after May 2, 2005) are automatically listed on GoDaddy Auctions ~26 days after expiration. This is NOT optional. The domain goes through a 10-day auction + 5-day closeout BEFORE it can ever reach public pendingDelete. Dynadot backorders will ONLY work if the domain passes through GoDaddy Auctions unsold AND the closeout unsold AND then survives the redemption period to reach pendingDelete.
research_summary.bottom_line: For premium one-word .coms like olive.com, the probability of surviving GoDaddy Auctions unsold is effectively ZERO. HugeDomains alone dominates GoDaddy expired auctions with automated bots, buying 56%+ of all sub-$500 expired domains. A one-word .com with $902M in press coverage will attract hundreds of bidders. Our Dynadot $10.99 backorder strategy is inadequate for the premium GoDaddy domains.

timeline.day_1_to_5: Domain still active in account. Owner can manually renew at standard price.
timeline.day_5: Domain parked. Website and email stop working.
timeline.day_18: Domain no longer active in owner's account. Redemption fee required to recover.
timeline.day_26: CRITICAL: Domain listed on GoDaddy Auctions as 'Expired Domain'. Starting bid: $25 (raised from $12 in Oct 2023).
timeline.day_26_to_36: 10-day expired domain auction. Owner CAN still renew (but not if active bid exists). Proxy bidding system. HugeDomains bots actively sniping.
timeline.day_36_to_41: If no winner: domain moves to 'Final Closeout' for 5 days. Reverse auction starting at ~$50, declining daily to $5. First 'Buy Now' click wins.
timeline.day_41: Closeout ends. If purchased: winner gets domain. If NOT purchased: domain returned to registry.
timeline.day_41_to_72: Redemption grace period at registry level. Owner can still recover with high fee ($80-$120+renewal).
timeline.day_72: Domain removed from GoDaddy account permanently.
timeline.day_72_to_77: Registry holds domain in pendingDelete (typically 5 days for .com via Verisign).
timeline.day_76_to_77: Domain DROPS - becomes available for public registration. This is when Dynadot/DropCatch backorders would fire.

key_facts.all_domains_auctioned: YES - Most domains registered with GoDaddy after May 2, 2005 are automatically listed. No opt-out. No threshold. ALL of them go to auction.
key_facts.starting_bid: $25 (since Oct 30, 2023). Plus ~$10 renewal fee = effective $35 minimum.
key_facts.auction_membership_required: Yes - $4.99/year for GoDaddy Auctions membership to bid
key_facts.wild_west_domains_included: YES - Wild West Domains is a GoDaddy subsidiary (registrar #28 on the 29-registrar list). Same auction pipeline.
key_facts.29_registrars_feed_godaddy: GoDaddy, Wild West Domains, Enom, Tucows, Name.com, Squarespace, Wix, Hostinger, and 21 others all feed expired domains to GoDaddy Auctions
key_facts.domain_reaches_public_drop_only_if: No bids during 10-day auction AND no buyer during 5-day closeout AND no redemption by owner during grace period. Then and ONLY then does it reach pendingDelete where Dynadot/DropCatch can catch it.

hugedomains_threat.description: HugeDomains uses automated bots on GoDaddy Auctions. Research shows they won 84 out of 150 recently lost auctions (56%). They dominate ALL auctions below ~$500.
hugedomains_threat.impact: Any domain with a recognizable English word will be bid on by HugeDomains bots. One-word .coms are their primary target.

dropcatch_vs_dynadot.odds_ratio: Roughly 100:1 in DropCatch's favor for catching dropped domains
dropcatch_vs_dynadot.conclusion: Even IF a domain survives GoDaddy Auctions and reaches pendingDelete, Dynadot has roughly 1% the catch rate of DropCatch. For premium domains, DropCatch backorders are essential.

premium_domain_competition.one_word_com_budget: Budget at least $10,000 for quality one-word .coms
premium_domain_competition.typical_expired_premium_sale: $2,500-$15,000+ at GoDaddy Auctions for recognizable domains
premium_domain_competition.example: A NamePros user reported their domain sold for $15,000 at GoDaddy expired auctions

domain_characteristics.brandability: EXCEPTIONAL - universal brand appeal across food, tech, health, fashion
domain_characteristics.comparable_sales: One-word food .coms: cream.com ($250K), butter.com, etc. Dictionary .coms routinely $50K-$500K+

domain_risk_assessments.reasoning: olive.com is a 5-letter, one-word, common English dictionary .com registered since 1996. This is the absolute top tier of expiring domain inventory. HugeDomains bots will bid instantly. Professional domain investors monitor GoDaddy expiring auctions daily. With $902M in press coverage from Olive AI, this domain will attract massive attention. There is essentially zero chance this domain passes through GoDaddy Auctions unsold.
domain_risk_assessments.recommended_strategy: GoDaddy Auctions bid required. Budget $10,000-$50,000 minimum. Consider setting max proxy bid. Also place DropCatch backorder ($59) as insurance. Dynadot backorder is worthless for this domain.

domain_characteristics.comparable_sales: Two-word compound brand .coms: typically $500-$5,000 at auction

domain_risk_assessments.reasoning: infarm.com is a brandable 6-letter compound word. Not a dictionary word but highly brandable for agtech/farming. HugeDomains would likely bid $25-$200 on this. Domain investors would recognize the farm keyword value. 27-year domain age adds authority. High probability of selling at GoDaddy Auctions but not at olive.com levels. Small chance it reaches closeout and potentially drops.
domain_risk_assessments.recommended_strategy: Place GoDaddy Auctions bid ($500-$2,000 range). Also place DropCatch backorder ($59) as backup. Dynadot backorder unlikely to fire.

domain_characteristics.comparable_sales: 4-letter .coms: routinely $1,000-$20,000+ at auction. Premium CVCV patterns: $5,000-$50,000

domain_risk_assessments.reasoning: veev.com is a 4-letter .com - one of the most valuable expired domain categories. Only 456,976 possible 4-letter .com combinations exist. The CVCV (consonant-vowel) pattern makes it pronounceable and highly brandable. Professional domain investors actively hunt 4-letter .coms. HugeDomains would bid instantly. There is also the Veeva Systems (VEEV on NYSE) brand confusion factor that could drive bidding. Near-zero chance of reaching public drop.
domain_risk_assessments.recommended_strategy: GoDaddy Auctions bid required. Budget $5,000-$20,000. Place DropCatch backorder ($59) as insurance. Dynadot backorder is worthless.

domain_characteristics.brandability: LOW - generic 'Inc' suffix, Fisker brand is dead, trademark liability risk
domain_characteristics.comparable_sales: CompanyNameInc .coms: typically $25-$200 at auction, often reach closeout

domain_risk_assessments.reasoning: fiskerinc.com has the 'Inc' suffix which dramatically reduces brandability. The Fisker brand is bankrupt with trademark baggage. No one wants to buy 'FiskerInc.com' for a new brand - they would want 'Fisker.com' (which is a different domain). HugeDomains might bid $25 on it speculatively but could also skip it. Moderate chance this reaches closeout and potentially drops. The $1.5B funding is irrelevant to domain value because the 'Inc' suffix kills reusability.
domain_risk_assessments.recommended_strategy: Place DropCatch backorder ($59) as primary. Dynadot backorder ($10.99) as secondary. GoDaddy Auctions bid optional ($25-$100 max). This is the one GoDaddy domain most likely to survive to public drop.

domain_characteristics.brandability: MODERATE - energy/EV sector brand, 'volt' keyword has value
domain_characteristics.comparable_sales: Two-word compound .coms with keyword value: $200-$2,000 at auction

domain_risk_assessments.reasoning: northvolt.com has brand recognition from $13B in funding and massive press coverage. However, it is a 9-letter compound brand name, not a dictionary word. The 'volt' keyword has energy/EV sector value. HugeDomains would likely bid $25-$100 on this. Domain investors might recognize the Northvolt brand and bid higher. BUT: Northvolt is in Chapter 11 proceedings - the bankruptcy estate may actually renew/reclaim this domain before it expires, as the brand has value in restructuring. This domain may never actually expire.
domain_risk_assessments.recommended_strategy: Place GoDaddy Auctions bid ($200-$1,000 range). DropCatch backorder ($59) as backup. Monitor bankruptcy proceedings - domain may be reclaimed by restructured entity.

domain_characteristics.brandability: LOW-MODERATE - long, niche autonomous driving brand, 14 chars
domain_characteristics.comparable_sales: Long compound brand .coms: typically $25-$100 at auction, often reach closeout

domain_risk_assessments.reasoning: ghostautonomy.com is a 14-character compound brand name at Wild West Domains (GoDaddy subsidiary - CONFIRMED same auction pipeline). The 'ghost' and 'autonomy' words individually have some value, but the compound is long and niche. HugeDomains may bid $25 speculatively but the length works against it. Only 4 years old, minimal domain authority. URGENT: expires 2026-06-07, only 23 days away. The GoDaddy auction would start ~July 3 (day 26 after expiry) and run through ~July 18 (end of closeout).
domain_risk_assessments.recommended_strategy: URGENT - expires in 23 days. Place DropCatch backorder ($59) immediately. GoDaddy Auctions bid ($25-$100 range) when it appears. Dynadot backorder ($10.99) as tertiary backup. Domain would drop ~Aug 22 if it survives all phases.

tier_1_must_bid_at_godaddy.reason: Premium short/one-word .coms that will NEVER survive GoDaddy Auctions. Zero chance of reaching public pendingDelete. Dynadot backorders are useless for these.
tier_1_must_bid_at_godaddy.action: Create GoDaddy Auctions account ($4.99/yr membership). Set proxy bids. Budget $10K-$50K for olive.com, $5K-$20K for veev.com.
tier_1_must_bid_at_godaddy.reality_check: If budget is below $5,000, these domains are out of reach. Domain investors and HugeDomains will outbid.

tier_2_should_bid_at_godaddy.reason: Brandable compound names with keyword value. High probability of selling at GoDaddy Auctions but not at extreme premiums.
tier_2_should_bid_at_godaddy.action: GoDaddy Auctions bids ($500-$2,000 range). Also place DropCatch backorders ($59 each) as fallback.

tier_3_backorder_may_work.reason: Long or branded-with-suffix domains that have reasonable chance of passing through GoDaddy Auctions unsold.
tier_3_backorder_may_work.action: Place DropCatch backorders ($59 each). Place low GoDaddy Auctions bids ($25-$100). Dynadot backorders ($10.99) as last resort.

dynadot_strategy_adjustment.current_strategy: Dynadot backorders at $10.99 for all domains
dynadot_strategy_adjustment.problem: Dynadot backorders only fire AFTER pendingDelete. GoDaddy domains go through 10-day auction + 5-day closeout + 30-day redemption BEFORE pendingDelete. Premium domains get sold during GoDaddy Auctions phase, never reaching Dynadot.
dynadot_strategy_adjustment.additional_problem: Even if a domain reaches pendingDelete, Dynadot has ~15 ICANN accreditations vs DropCatch's 1,200+. Roughly 1% catch rate vs DropCatch.
dynadot_strategy_adjustment.revised_strategy: Keep Dynadot backorders as cheapest insurance. ADD DropCatch backorders ($59) for all 6 domains. ADD GoDaddy Auctions bids for olive.com, veev.com, infarm.com, northvolt.com.

key_answer_olive_com.question: If olive.com ($902M funded company, premium one-word .com) is at GoDaddy, will GoDaddy EVER let it reach public pendingDelete?
key_answer_olive_com.answer: NO. olive.com will be purchased during GoDaddy's expired domain auction phase, almost certainly within the first 10-day auction period, likely at $10,000-$100,000+. GoDaddy does not 'hold back' or reserve domains - they auction ALL expired domains at a $25 starting bid. But the market does the filtering: HugeDomains bots, professional domain investors, and brand-seeking companies all monitor GoDaddy expired auctions. A one-word, 5-letter, common English noun .com from 1996 is the holy grail of expired domains. It will NEVER reach pendingDelete. To acquire olive.com, you must bid at GoDaddy Auctions and be prepared to spend $10,000-$100,000+.
